first_order: bringing an r/monero script to draw AEON beside Monero
author: dnale0r
text: We from /r/monero created a script that will draw an AEON logo to the left of the Monero logo. It will also draw a small Kovri logo and maintain our beloved Snowman
note: The poster presents help originating in r/monero and includes Kovri and the Snowman in the drawing script.

first_order: telling people to paste the drawing script and hit ENTER
author: dnale0r
text:
Please run this script as follows:


* Log in to reddit

* go to https://www.reddit.com/place?webview=true

* go to console using F12 in Chrome

* copy paste script and hit ENTER :)

https://pastebin.com/GT0jkfJs


ENJOY !!
note: The linked pastebin holds part of the means of action that is not visible in this record.
